name: gloss-ai
description: Gloss AI monorepo: the browser extension (apps/extension) and its API (services/api). Each has its own dependencies and lockfile; these scripts only delegate.

scripts.install:all: pnpm --dir services/api install && pnpm --dir apps/extension install
scripts.test: pnpm --dir services/api test && pnpm --dir apps/extension test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --dir services/api exec tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && pnpm --dir apps/extension typecheck
scripts.build: pnpm --dir services/api build && pnpm --dir apps/extension build
